answer: The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, published publicly on failure, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Every claim climbs the anchor of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the gale re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. By the relic of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
